newsrooms.label: Newsrooms
newsrooms.hub_blurb: Not the update, the thread underneath it, connected across every meeting it touched.
newsrooms.headline: You already cover the update. We connect what it's part of.
newsrooms.sub: A newsroom we work with told us directly: the first version of this was “update me”, things that happened, most of which they already knew. That's their strength already, and it's not where they needed help. So we rebuilt around threads: a topic on the record across multiple meetings and several weeks, with the date it started, the material perspective and explainer pieces are actually made of, not another item on the list.

stats.label: of these documents are invisible to search
records requests needed, all already public

newsrooms.jobs_title: A thread is not a document. It's where a story started.
newsrooms.jobs_sub: One meeting is an item. The same topic returning meeting after meeting, over weeks, dated from the first time it appeared, that's a thread, and it's closer to the shape a real story has.

jobs.title: The topic connected across meetings, not one at a time
jobs.body: A budget line, a zoning question, a grant application, the same subject returning meeting after meeting, with the date each one starts. One document is an item. Three meetings over nine weeks is a thread, and it reads as one.

jobs.title: Built for the coverage you don't already have
jobs.body: Every thread we surface is tagged by which of your own reader needs it actually serves. We're not trying to beat you at “this happened”, you already do that well. We're pointed at what's harder to staff: perspective, connection, the deeper piece.

jobs.title: Where a thread started, before you had to go looking
jobs.body: By the time a topic is obviously a story, the record already shows where it began. We hand you that starting point and every meeting since, so the reporting time goes into the piece, not into reconstructing the timeline.

workflow.text: You define the beat: topics, states, and the jurisdictions you cover.
We run the classification weekly and connect what returns across meetings.
You get threads with source links and dates, ready to report against.

newsrooms.cta_note: One intake form. One live thread on your beat. No cost, no call required.
newsrooms.cta_title: Tell us your beat. We will find one thread already forming in the record.
newsrooms.cta_body: Newsroom budgets are not our pricing model. Send us the beat and the geography and we will run one assessment free, source links included.
